_comment: Hosts that must never be crawled or re-added by discovery. This is how a supplier's removal request is honored durably — deleting an entry from suppliers.json alone does not work, because the next discovery run re-adds it. Matching includes subdomains: 'example.com' also denies 'inventory.example.com'. Use: python -m stonescan.denylist add <host> --reason "..."

denied.reason: robots.txt disallows all non-search crawlers on both the storefront and the catalog host; excluded by policy, not by oversight
